name: touch-playthrough
description: #202: a diagnostic of #120 stretch 2's blocker, on the #202 branch only (the merged scenario is stretch 1). The input is the generated segments touch-1-first-battle, touch-2-md1-1-diagnostic (runner/test/unit/playthrough-scenarios.js). Stretch 1's waits still fail the scenario on a timeout. End checks: field mode; and, as signs whatever the checks say: dx_p0, dy_p0 (PosX/PosY change over the whole probe), dy_p200 (PosY since 200 frames into it); g1x, g1x2, g1y (gateway 1 x1, x2, y1 against Cloud at the end); raw map_cur and game_state at the end. Only signs and small state values leave.
